description: Every LA Metro bus or rail route, with its route code, short and long name, direction description and map colour. AUTHORITATIVE for "what routes does LA Metro run" — sourced from LACMTA's own API, not a third-party scrape. Use the returned route_code as input to lametro_route_stops.

agency.description: 'LACMTA' for bus (default, ~124 routes) or 'LACMTA_Rail' for the rail and busway lines (A/B/C/D/E/K, ~6).

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter over route name and description (e.g. "Wilshire", "Rapid").

name: lametro_routes
title: Lametro Routes
